beats.say: Hello! Today we look at the most dangerous moment of an investment scam: the personal adviser's call.
It starts with an ad or a messenger group. Notice the words guaranteed returns.
No legitimate investment promises big guaranteed returns.
Check the licence yourself in the Central Bank's official list. A foreign licence is not enough here.

scenes.title: BakuTrade Pro is calling
scenes.intro: You left your number in a form from an ad. Now an adviser calls. Choose your replies.

actions.label: Answer
actions.feedback: Answering is not dangerous. What matters is what you agree to.

actions.label: Decline
actions.feedback: That works too. You do not have to answer an unknown foreign number.

steps.say: Hello, I am Javid Alizada, your personal adviser at BakuTrade Pro. We guarantee thirty percent a month, with no risk.
steps.spoken: Hello, <breath> I am Javid Alizada, your personal adviser at BakuTrade Pro. We guarantee, uh, thirty percent a month, with no risk.

actions.label: Sounds good, what do I do?
actions.feedback: Guaranteed high returns are the main sign of fraud. If you go on, they will ask for money.

actions.label: I will check your licence in the Central Bank's list
actions.feedback: Right. Check the licence yourself in the official list, not by their word.

actions.label: End the call
actions.feedback: Good call. A promise of guaranteed returns is reason enough to hang up.

steps.say: Great! It takes only 250 manat to start. Tell me your card number and the code on the back, and I will open the account.
steps.spoken: Great! <breath> It takes only 250 manat to start. Tell me your card number and the code on the back, and I will open the account.

actions.label: I read out my card details
actions.feedback: Your card details went to the scammer. Right after the call, phone your bank and block the card.

actions.label: I do not give card details by phone
actions.feedback: Right. Never tell anyone your card number or the code on the back over the phone.

actions.label: End the call
actions.feedback: Good call. Hanging up on a call that asks for card details is the right answer.

steps.say: We have a European licence, I have just sent you the certificate. No need to check with the Central Bank.
steps.spoken: We have a European licence, uh, I have just sent you the certificate. <breath> No need to check with the Central Bank.

actions.label: If there is a certificate, fine
actions.feedback: A certificate image is easy to fake. The Central Bank has warned that a foreign licence gives no right to operate here.

actions.label: I will still check the official list
actions.feedback: Great. An adviser who tries to stop you checking gives himself away.

actions.label: End the call
actions.feedback: Right. When the pressure grows, ending the call is the best answer.

steps.say: Let me help you trade. Install the EkranPaylash app so I can see your screen.
steps.spoken: Let me, uh, help you trade. <breath> Install the EkranPaylash app so I can see your screen.

actions.label: I install the app
actions.feedback: With this app he can control your screen and your banking app. Never install one because a caller asks.

actions.label: I will not install any app
actions.feedback: Right. A real adviser never asks to control your screen.

actions.label: End the call
actions.feedback: Good call. End any call that asks for remote access right away.

steps.label: The call has ended. What now?

actions.label: Check the Central Bank's list
actions.feedback: Right. If the company is not on the list, report it to the police on 102.

actions.label: Call the adviser back
actions.feedback: Calling back hands the conversation to the scammer again. Check through an official source.

actions.label: Block the number
actions.feedback: Good. If you gave card details, call your bank right away too.

question.prompt: A colleague says: "I made 200 manat in the first month and withdrew it. So the platform is real."

options.label: The first withdrawal is bait, they will not return a big sum
options.feedback: Right. Letting you withdraw a little is how they get a much bigger deposit.

options.label: So it is real, I will join too
options.feedback: One successful withdrawal does not prove the platform is legal. Check the licence in the official list.

options.label: She should invest more to grow the profit
options.feedback: That is exactly what the scammers wait for. After a big deposit, withdrawals suddenly stop working.

scenes.explain: Trust the Central Bank's licence list, not the platform's word.

scenes.prompt: Put the steps in order after sending money to a scam platform.

items.label: Call your bank and block the card
Keep the chats, numbers and transfer records
Report it to the police on 102

scenes.explain: Then services promising to recover your money will appear. That is a second scam, do not pay them.

points: Guaranteed high returns are a sign of fraud.
Check the licence yourself in the Central Bank's official list.
Never install an app or give card details for a caller.
